description: Blazor project and item templates with Telerik UI for Blazor and Docker integration. Configure the Telerik Blazor components via template options like CSS theme, icon type, localization, and RTL support.
releaseNotes:
NEW
* Added support for Telerik UI for Blazor 9.0.0

NOTE
The .NET 6 and .NET 7 project templates are deprecated and may not include all features. These templates are compatible with Telerik UI for Blazor version 8.x, but are not compatible with version 9.x.
title: Telerik Blazor Project and Item Templates
